{"consolidated_memory":"CONSOLIDATED: Message Redelivery Issues in worker/queue/consumer.py (Two Separate Incidents)

File affected: worker/queue/consumer.py (background jobs side)
Recurring symptom: same message id handled more than once (message redelivery)
Reproduction method: kill the worker mid-batch and restart it

---

OCCASION 1: [2026-01-31]
Affected users: those sitting in a negative UTC offset
Root cause: schema drift between the migration and the model
Fix: regenerated the model from the migration and pinned the checksum
PR #3687 on branch fix/message-redelivery-1
Outcome: alert stayed quiet for 19 consecutive days

OCCASION 2: [2026-08-06]
Affected clients: those still pinned to the v1 SDK
Root cause: clock skew between the two hosts
Fix: switched the deadline to a monotonic clock
PR #6351 on branch fix/message-redelivery-2
Stack: Python
Covering test: tests/worker/test_consumer.py
Outcome: flaky test went from 48 failures per hundred runs to zero

Note: These incidents are related to the same component and both involved consumer message redelivery work in worker/queue/consumer.py, with context carrying over from earlier message redelivery work."}
